title: Balance Sheet FUNdamentals! The Accounting Equation and Beyond
description: A one-session, 2-hour online workshop from A Bookkeeping Cooperative going deeper into key accounting concepts — the accounting equation, journal entries, debits and credits — aimed at people who already have a solid foundational understanding of financial reports. Sliding-scale tickets ($75-$600). Part of ABC's ongoing public workshop series on financial education for cooperatives and mission-driven organizations.
